claimedSlice: opencv2/sfm.hpp plus all nine installed opencv2/sfm/*.hpp headers, including standalone robust.hpp and the Ceres reconstruction/pipeline surface; exact non-wrapper declarations preserve per-header Ceres build gates and upstream incomplete-runtime boundaries
limitation: The map records parser identities and exact Sfm wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: The SFM module requires external Eigen, Glog and Gflags plus a successful SFM_GLOG_GFLAGS_TEST compile/link probe; this package provides no SFM native/managed wrapper.

The reconstruction and simple pipeline implementations require external Ceres Solver and CERES_LIBRARIES; defining CERES_FOUND as zero may expose direct header declarations but does not enable those implementations.
Image sequences/paths, point tracks, reconstruction files, camera intrinsics, output Mat ownership and reconstruction state are caller-provided; the package bundles no SFM scene or track assets.
